howToUse: Read AGENTS.md, then the component contract (COMPONENT.md). Copy files into the project; do not install a package.

components.name: parsons
components.title: Parsons puzzle
components.summary: Put given code pieces in the right order, or drop them into the gaps of fixed code. Drag, tap or keyboard; exact, shared scoring.

variants.summary: Order whole lines; optional indentation by the solver; red herring lines.
Fixed code with gaps; drop pieces in, ordered or any order; decoy gaps; reusable pieces.
